verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Create Card API call (marqeta-docs-1), an accessible sandbox with interactive widgets (marqeta-docs-2,3,19) and 'instant-issue virtual cards ready for immediate use' (marqeta-docs-12,16), supporting the core create-in-one-call and instant-issue claims. However there is no explicit confirmation that PAN/CVV/expiry are all returned synchronously in the same API response, and going live is described as leveraging 'existing relationships with issuing banks, networks, and card fulfillment providers to go live in days not months' (marqeta-docs-27), which implies a managed onboarding/partnership process rather than a pure self-serve sandbox-to-production flow with no sales involvement. missing for 10: explicit API response schema showing PAN/CVV/expiry returned on card creation, and evidence of self-serve production activation without a sales/partnership process.
